_comment: Aeldari Faction Pack v1.4. Complete datasheet, army rule, detachment and enhancement rules.

Strands of Fate.note: Fate dice pool at start of battle. Substitute 1 Fate die per phase for Advance, Battle-shock, Charge, Damage, Hit, Save, or Wound roll.

Battle Focus.note: Receive Battle Focus tokens each round based on battle size. Spend 1 token to trigger Agile Manoeuvres.

Agile Manoeuvres.note: Manoeuvres: Swift as the Wind (+2" M), Flitting Shadows (no Overwatch), Star Engines ([ASSAULT] on vehicles), Sudden Strike (6" pile-in/consolidate), Opportunity Seized (normal move D6+1" on enemy fallback), Fade Back (normal move D6+1" after hit).

Disparate Paths.note: Can include Harlequins units in your army even without Asuryani keyword.

Branching Fates (Psychic).note: Once per turn, you can change the result of one Fate dice to a 6.

Defenders of the Shrines.note: At end of Command phase, if this unit controls an objective, roll D6: on 4+, gain 1 Fate die.

Diviner of Futures.note: At start of battle, gain 3 additional Fate dice.

Doom (Psychic).note: In Shooting phase, select 1 visible enemy unit within 18": attacks against it add 1 to Wound roll.

Guide (Psychic).note: While leading a unit, models in that unit can re-roll the Hit roll.

Hand of Asuryan.note: While leading a unit, each time a model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Bladestorm.note: Ranged Critical Hits have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Fire Support.note: Units that disembarked from this transport can re-roll the Wound roll for attacks targeting an enemy unit hit by this transport.

Linked Fire.note: Each time a Fire Prism shoots, it can draw line of sight and range from another friendly Fire Prism, and can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1.

Storm of Blades.note: Ranged attacks have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Cry of the Wind.note: Once per battle, at end of opponent's turn, remove from battlefield and place into Reserves.

Burning Lance.note: Feel No Pain 5+. While below Starting Strength, add 1 to Hit and Wound rolls.

Harvester of Souls.note: While leading a unit, add 1 to Attacks of ranged weapons.

The Bloody-Handed (Aura).note: Friendly AELDARI units within 6" re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls.

Molten Form.note: Each time an attack is allocated to this model, halve the Damage characteristic.

Spirit Mark (Psychic).note: While leading a unit, each time a Wraith Construct makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Tears of Isha (Psychic).note: In your Command phase, select one friendly Wraith Construct model within 6": that model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

Word of the Phoenix (Psychic).note: In your Command phase, select one friendly Ynnari unit within 6": return D3 destroyed models.

Herald of Ynnead.note: While leading a unit, models in that unit have Feel No Pain 5+.

Yvraine’s Champion.note: While leading a unit, models in that unit have the Fights First ability.

Inevitable Death.note: When a unit is destroyed, set up this model within 1" of where that unit was destroyed.

Blitz.note: Once per battle, when selected to move: +2D6" Move and +3 Attacks until end of turn.

Dance of Death.note: While leading a unit, melee weapons have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

Choreographer of War.note: While leading a unit, eligible to charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Fog of Dreams (Psychic).note: While leading a unit, ranged attacks targeting that unit subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Death is Not Enough.note: Ranged attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified 5+.

Flip Belt.note: Can move over enemy models and terrain as if they were not there.

Shimmershield.note: Bearer's unit has a 4+ invulnerable save.

Shadow Field.note: Bearer has a 2+ invulnerable save (lost until end of battle if failed).

Wave Serpent Shield.note: Ranged attacks targeting this model subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Fleet of Foot.note: Can re-roll Advance rolls and Charge rolls.

Flickerjump.note: When selected to make a Normal move, can teleport up to 24".

Indomitable Strength of Will.note: In your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot, can shoot back at that enemy unit.

Mandiblasters.note: Each time this unit makes a Charge move, roll D6 for each model in Engagement Range: on 4+ deal 1 mortal wound.

Storm of Silence.note: While leading a unit, add 2" to Move and +1 to Advance and Charge rolls.

Sadistic Raiders.note: Objective marker remains under your control even if no models within range (sticky objective).

Unparalleled Foresight.note: Battle Host detachment: each time this unit is selected to shoot or fight, re-roll one Hit roll and re-roll one Wound roll.

Martial Grace.note: Warhost detachment: receive +1 Battle Focus token; Swift as the Wind gives +1" additional M.

Defend at All Costs.note: If this unit or target unit is within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Path of the Warrior.note: Aspect Host detachment: select re-roll Hit 1s or re-roll Wound 1s.
